# Source: Bust of a Youth (Saint John the Baptist)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Bust of a Youth (Saint John the Baptist)
- **Artist / culture:** Francesco Mochi (Italian, 1580–1654)
- **Date:** 1630-40
- **Style:** Baroque
- **Classification:** bust/head
- **Department:** Painting and Sculpture of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 73413
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/73413
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/4e37b182-cc1e-ef86-3eb2-de7d5b9db717/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Baroque

## Extracted source palette

`#888888, #A8A8A8, #080808, #282828, #D8C8B8, #A89888, #E8E8D8, #887868`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#040404`
- `surface`: `#212121`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#888888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#E8E8D8`
- `surface_variant`: `#212121`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#484848`
- `error`: `#888888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `cinzel` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `19.28:1`, surface `15.14:1`
- Variant contrast: `15.14:1`
- Control contrast: `5.51:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
